about_the_game:
The Calamity of Xiangshu devours all; demons run rampant as heaven and earth collapse.

The Realm of Taiwu is a Roguelite game blending survival, loot collection, and multiplayer gameplay.

Gods have fallen silent. Destiny lies broken.
Alone, you tread the Boundless Path to gather scattered sacred blades, confront the world-devouring calamity, and ignite the last ember of hope in the wasteland.
This is not merely a journey to slay demons—
It is a trial of fate. An awakening of conviction.

Slay Like Mowing Grass, Forge Your Soul in Battle

Demonic tides surge; death lurks at every turn. You must fight your way out, time and again, from the brink of annihilation.
Tonnes of skill combos. Diverse builds. Ever-shifting battlefields.
Every run reshapes your path to carnage from scratch.
With each swing, demon blood rains down;
With each step through flames, no blade of grass survives.
Exhilarating combat flows from your mastery of every inch of the battlefield. Grow stronger with each fight, delve into the spiraling depths, and reclaim the fallen sacred blades.

Echoes of Fallen Gods, Relics of a Forgotten Age

This is a forsaken world. Divine beings have long perished; truth lies buried in steles, fragments, and ruins.
Sanctuaries once brimming with faith now breed madness and strangeness—
Here, you seek answers.
Pause to hear ancient steles speak, decipher relics, and piece together the origin of this cataclysm—
Or carve your truth in blood and steel.
The choice—and the truth—is yours.

Fight Together, Hold Back the Falling Sky

Alone, you can carve a path to dawn;
Together, you can reshape the world.
Summon allies through multiplayer to withstand the waves of destruction.
When peril closes in, someone guards your back;
As doom looms, someone shares your light.
No survivor walks alone.

Where Sacred Blades Fall, Demons Rise

Huanyin has perished. The Great Wu has yet to come.
Only the blade in your hand proves this world still breathes.
The day nine sacred blades unite is the day mankind is reborn.

short_description: Demons ravage, calamities rage. Xiangshu's scourge devours the mortal realm. In this ink-wash dark fantasy world, you'll wander, unearth rare treasures, reclaim divine swords. Seek like-minded companions to save the world. Survive—in this dimming world, you can still kindle a faint light.

English, Simplified Chinese*
